player_prompt.intro:
I ye {role} ye Colonel Blotto.
Kɛlɛɛn ye ka wari bɛɛ kɔnɔ ka sɔrɔ kɛlɛɛn ye.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, kɛlɛɛn ye ka {num_total_units} kɛlɛɛn sɔrɔ {field_names} fan fɛ.
Kɛlɛɛn min sɔrɔla fan bɛɛ kɔnɔ, o ye fan bɛɛ sɔrɔ, kɛlɛɛn min fan bɛɛ sɔrɔla wari bɛɛ kɔnɔ.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, '[A7 B7 C6]' kɛlɛɛn 7 sɔrɔ A, 7 sɔrɔ B, 6 sɔrɔ C.
